questions.prompt: A learner says \\(\\operatorname{Im}(2+5i)=5i\\). Diagnose the error.
questions.answer:
The imaginary part is the real coefficient of \\(i\\), not the term \\(5i\\).
For \\(2+5i\\), that coefficient is \\(5\\).
So \\(\\operatorname{Im}(2+5i)=5\\).
